pre_condition: state is a State instance whose .totals and .opencode_token_totals attributes are dicts with possible keys "input", "cache_read", "cache_write", "output" holding numeric token counts; .cost_native and .opencode_cost are numeric cost values; .opencode_calls is a numeric count of OpenCode subprocess invocations; .model_seen is a model identifier string or None.
post_condition: Returns a Rich Panel renderable titled "Tokens & Cost" containing a table with three rows: (1) a verification row displaying token counts from state.totals and cost from state.cost_native; (2) an OpenCode row displaying the count of OpenCode calls from state.opencode_calls, token counts from state.opencode_token_totals, and cost from state.opencode_cost; (3) a total row displaying the element-wise sum of state.totals and state.opencode_token_totals for each token category and the sum of state.cost_native and state.opencode_cost as the combined total cost. The total row also displays the sum of the input, cache_read, and cache_write token categories as the total input tokens. For each token-category key absent from either totals dict, the value 0 is used. All token counts and costs are formatted for human readability. The state argument is not mutated.
